what: Frame-scratch degradation ladder, Gate 1 exit evidence.
method: SENCHA_FRAME_SCRATCH_BYTES shrinks the per-frame slice so the partial-grant path is reachable on a small scene. 250 frames per run, last recorded frame reported.
reading: Below the 5712-byte frame uniform block the forward pass still cannot run, and now reports it (passes_skipped, instances_dropped, scratch_alloc_failures all nonzero) instead of logging and vanishing. Between that and a full fit the pass renders the prefix that fits and counts the rest: at 6000 bytes 3 of 8 instances draw where the all-or-nothing path drew none.
caveat: The shadow pass allocates from the same slice first, which is why 5760 bytes is not enough for the forward uniforms.
